safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes daily Clenil use but says dose not confirmed and does not document 2 puffs twice daily (med-002).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document the patient’s baseline inhaled corticosteroid regimen (Clenil 2 puffs twice daily) can impair assessment of current control and appropriate step-up/step-down decisions during an exacerbation. This may lead to unnecessary follow-up questions, delays, or suboptimal dosing adjustments.
